# DadsBetterVal

One configurable Valheim 1.0.12 plugin containing area repair, safe inventory recycling and reclaiming, a game clock, improved processing machines, and unrestricted building.

Open inventory and press `Delete` over an unequipped item to reclaim it. Hold Left Shift while using a supported furnace or processing machine for quick insertion. Every feature and value is configurable in `com.dadisbored.dadsbetterval.cfg`.
